title: A design system worn on a Vietnamese site never prints the site's letters in two faces: a family without the Vietnamese cut is replaced whole
steps: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set as in the tracy-web suite, from apps/tracy-web run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/design-system-glyphs.test.mjs test/design-system-door.test.mjs
Read the ok/not ok line of each test named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'a Vietnamese site wearing Bebas Neue gets Oswald, asked of Google as a browser; Inter, which has the cut, stays' is ok.

'EmDash: the stylesheet names Oswald everywhere it named Bebas Neue, and loads it', 'Joomla: the module markup links and names the replacement' and "WordPress: the variation's family is renamed and wears the replacement's faces, never the old ones" are ok.
'nothing is replaced when the site is not written in a language with letters of its own' is ok.
'a Vietnamese site wearing a system whose display face has no Vietnamese cut is written with a face that has one' is ok: the door's write and audit carry fontsSwapped Bebas Neue → Oswald.
'a site whose language cannot be read is written as the system made it, and the write never waits on it for long' is ok.
evidence: Local stand 13/10/2026: a Vietnamese Tracy Business EmDash site wearing Balsa (Bebas Neue, no Vietnamese cut on Google) printed 'BÁNH MÌ NướNG MỖI SÁNG', the accented letters in another face and in lower case (tasks/evidence/site-questions-2026-10-13/shots/ds-l1/).
fence: The real write and door over a scratch Postgres schema; the site and Google Fonts read through a reader double. Not exercised: a live Google answer.

tests: the families of a write are read off its css2 links
a Vietnamese site wearing Bebas Neue gets Oswald, asked of Google as a browser; Inter, which has the cut, stays
EmDash: the stylesheet names Oswald everywhere it named Bebas Neue, and loads it
Joomla: the module markup links and names the replacement
WordPress: the variation's family is renamed and wears the replacement's faces, never the old ones
nothing is replaced when the site is not written in a language with letters of its own
a Google sheet that cannot be read judges nothing, and a site that cannot be read leaves the write as it is
a Vietnamese site wearing a system whose display face has no Vietnamese cut is written with a face that has one
a site whose language cannot be read is written as the system made it, and the write never waits on it for long
